# Linketto

> Linketto is the multilingual "link in bio" page: all your links, products
> and contacts on one page that speaks every visitor's language (27 interface
> locales: all 24 official EU languages plus Neapolitan, Sicilian and Lombard dialects, chosen manually). EU-hosted,
> GDPR by default, cookie-free analytics, sales commissions 8/4/0/0% by plan.
> A product of Carbon Stealth VCC (Bulgaria, EU) — https://carbonstealth.eu.

## Main pages

- [English](https://linketto.carbonstealth.eu/en): product overview, features, pricing, FAQ
- [Български](https://linketto.carbonstealth.eu/bg)
- [Italiano](https://linketto.carbonstealth.eu/it)
- [Español](https://linketto.carbonstealth.eu/es)
- [Deutsch](https://linketto.carbonstealth.eu/de)
- [Français](https://linketto.carbonstealth.eu/fr)

## Facts

- Plans: Free €0 (8% commission), Pro €4/mo (4%), Business €9/mo (0%), Founder €49 one-time (0% forever)
- Sellers additionally pay a 1.9% + €0.30 payment processing fee per sale
- Analytics without cookies: no IP addresses, no user agents, no personal data
- Public profiles: https://linketto.carbonstealth.eu/u/<name>, automatic visitor-language selection
- Digital product shop via Stripe Connect; delivery only after confirmed payment

## Free tools and comparisons

- [Free QR code generator](https://linketto.carbonstealth.eu/en/tools/qr): in the browser, no sign-up, no watermark
- [Free AI bio generator](https://linketto.carbonstealth.eu/en/tools/bio): a short "link in bio" text in 24 languages
- [Linketto vs Linktree](https://linketto.carbonstealth.eu/en/vs/linktree) and [Linketto vs Beacons](https://linketto.carbonstealth.eu/en/vs/beacons): verified facts with sources and date
